title: Dallas Mavericks Fan Rejects Proposal During Mavs & Lakers Game [Watch]
htmlContent:
The Los Angeles Lakers secured a thrilling 111-108 victory over the Dallas Mavericks on Sunday afternoon, in a game that had fans on the edge of their seats at the end of the game. The Lakers, led by LeBron James and Anthony Davis, managed to hold off a late rally from the Mavericks to secure the win.

The game got off to a fast-paced start, with both teams trading baskets in the opening minutes. The Lakers managed to get down big early, and finished the first quarter down 28-16. The Mavericks lead most of the game until the fourth quarter with solid play from Luka Doncic, Kyrie Irving, Tim Hardaway Jr.

As the game progressed, it became clear that Dallas was determined to come out on top. However, the Lakers continued to rely on James and Davis to carry the load on offense, while the Mavericks looked to Doncic and Kyrie Irving to continue leading the way. The game seemed out of reach for the Los Angeles Lakers until they relied in the third and fourth quarters.

It wasn't until the fourth quarter that the Lakers managed to take the lead late in the fourth quarter with a three from Austin Reaves, and then both teams traded buckets down the stretch.

The Lakers managed to hold on, however, thanks to some clutch free throws from Anthony Davis, Dennis Schröder some solid defense in the final seconds. In the end, the Lakers secured the 111-108 victory, much to the delight of their fans in attendance.

The win was a big one for the Lakers, who have now one four of their last five games. With the victory, the Lakers improved to 29-32 on the season, and move up to 12th in the Western Conference standings. The Mavericks, meanwhile, fell to 32-30 on the season, and remain in the sixth seed in the Western Conference.

Overall, it was a thrilling game between two talented teams, and a reminder of just how exciting NBA basketball can be. With the playoffs fast approaching, both the Lakers and Mavericks will be looking to build momentum and make a push for the championship. For now, however, Lakers fans can celebrate a hard-fought victory, as they continue to try rise in the standings.

Speaking of which during the second quarter of the game at the 9:29 mark, a Mavericks fan attempted to proposal, but his girlfriend elected to run up the stairs and decline her boyfriend's proposal.

After the game Jason Kidd talked about the Mavericks blowing a 27 point league.

"“I’m not the savior here. I’m not playing. I’m watching, just like you guys. As a team, we’ve got to mature.”
